scope: Low-level DXF group-5 identity emission for NAVISWORKSMODELDEF and POINTCLOUDCOLORMAP.

behavior: Each writer remaps and reserves a nonzero source identity, or allocates an identity when the source handle is zero.
The source object identity is bound only after staged record output succeeds.
A fixed output identity is refused before publishing record bytes.
Late invalid-XDATA failure restores staged bytes, emitted-record inventory, and source-object identity-map changes; corrected retry is verified with a fresh writer.

validationProfile.source: Locally constructed in-memory AC1032 records. No DWG/DXF fixtures were added.
cases: Both record types remap group-5 identity and bind source-object identity to the emitted handle.
Typed callback readback checks modeled NAVISWORKSMODELDEF fields and POINTCLOUDCOLORMAP defaults and ramp payloads.
Both record types allocate and read back an identity when the source handle is zero.
Fixed-handle remap refusal preserves the destination.
Late invalid-XDATA rollback checks destination bytes, emitted-record inventory, and source-object identity map.
Corrected retry and typed readback use a fresh writer.

limitations: Generated identity transport only; it does not establish physical producer prevalence or source-to-output association for a complete external-definition graph.
Definition/owner target closure, external asset loading, native consumer behavior, and 3D consumer qualification remain open.
The late-failure test verifies byte, inventory, and source-object identity-map rollback, not handle-allocator reservation rollback; retry is verified on a fresh writer.
next: Qualify physical source records and close exact definition/owner target roles and dependencies before enabling adapter admission or native-consumer claims.
